question: Select the option that shows the correct age range of puberty in human male and female.
solution:
The correct answer is __**11-17 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Puberty is the phase of life when a child's body develops into an adult body capable of reproduction.
 
• In human males, puberty generally starts between the ages of 11 and 17 years.
 
• In human females, puberty usually begins earlier than in males, typically between ages 8 to 13, but the range can extend to 17 years.
 
• During puberty, both boys and girls experience various physical changes, including growth spurts, development of secondary sexual characteristics, and hormonal changes.
 
• The onset and duration of puberty can vary significantly among individuals due to genetic, environmental, and nutritional factors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hormonal Changes**

 
 
• During puberty, the body increases the production of hormones such as testosterone in males and estrogen and progesterone in females.
 
• These hormones are responsible for the development of secondary sexual characteristics like facial hair in males and breast development in females.
 
 
 
• **Growth Spurts**
 
 
• Puberty is often accompanied by rapid growth in height and weight, commonly known as growth spurts.
 
• These growth spurts are more pronounced during the early to mid-stages of puberty.
 
 
 
• **Psychological Changes**
 
 
• Along with physical changes, puberty is also a period of significant psychological and emotional development.
 
• Adolescents may experience mood swings, increased independence, and the development of a stronger sense of identity.
